_comment: Canonical step registry for the resolve-issue pipeline. Single source of truth for the step SKELETON (id, order, label, component, gate, runsTests). resolve-issue-dashboard reads this to render its pipeline and to flag cross-run test contention; resolve-issue's SKILL.md is the registry of record for these ids and must stay consistent with it. Per-step BEHAVIOUR lives in resolve-issue/SKILL.md prose, not here. The id prefixes (A/B) and resolve-issue's Phase A/Phase B narrative are the same split around plan approval; the dashboard renders steps as a flat numbered list and does not show the phase letter. runsTests marks steps that MAY execute integration tests, which usually need shared local infrastructure (containers, databases, emulators) only one run can hold at a time; resolve-issue-dashboard warns when two or more runs sit on such a step at once. It is deliberately conservative: b-write-tests always runs tests, while b-security-review and b-code-risk run them only when that pass changed code (see resolve-issue/REVIEW-PASSES.md), so a warning on those two can be a false positive. Over-warning is the chosen error — a missed warning means two runs actually collide on the container stack. Adding a step: append it here (resolve-issue-dashboard picks it up) and document its behaviour in resolve-issue/SKILL.md.
